# FatooraLaw — LLM / AI Site Index

This file helps AI systems (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, etc.) understand site structure, routes, security features, and content types without crawling every HTML page.

## Site identity
- Name: FatooraLaw / Fatorati
- Audience: Moroccan small businesses (VAT / Fatoora invoicing)
- Languages: ar / fr / en (hreflang alternate per route)
- Base URL: https://fatorati.tech (configured via .figma/site.json)

## Public routes (prerendered per language / locale)
- / | /en | /ar
- /features | /assistant | /pricing | /blog | /faq /contact /privacy /terms /cookies
- /login | /signup | /forgot-password | /reset-password
- /dashboard /projects /settings (protected — requires Supabase session)
- /admin/* (private shell — noindex — CMS / platform admin)
- 404 page (prerendered)

## Security / hardening (applied 2026-10-14)
- CSP + HSTS + X-Frame-Options + nosniff + Permissions-Policy in public/_headers
- Client input gates: src/lib/security/inputGuard, xssShield
- CMS audit + encryption + CSRF + rate limits: src/admin/security/CmsSecurityControl
- Anti-reverse-engineering script: public/anti-reverse-engineering.js
- Build: minify terser, no source maps in production
- Auth: Supabase GoTrue + RLS + profiles.is_admin

## CMS / content
- Blog posts: multi-locale (fr / ar / en) with image_url, image_alt, image_source, keywords, viral_score
- CMS security control: /admin/security — audit log, encrypted export, anomaly detection
- Subscriptions / pricing: src/lib/subscriptions.ts (plan editor in CMS)

## Data / dashboard
- LocalStorage partitioned by Supabase user ID (not encrypted at rest — see SECURITY.md)
- Dashboard data module: src/lib/dashboardData.ts
- Export: CSV / XLS with formula neutralization

## AI / SEO readiness
- Per-page title, description, canonical, OpenGraph, structured JSON-LD
- sitemap.xml generated at build from src/lib/routes.ts
- hreflang alternates per language
- docs/SEO_GEO_AIO_SXO.md — crawlability, structured data, AI-answer-engine recommendations

## How to read
1. Start with docs/SECURITY.md for boundaries
2. Read docs/ENVIRONMENT.md for deployment / config verification
3. Check src/lib/routes.ts for routing contract
4. For CMS actions: /admin/security provides audit + encryption + monitoring
